description:
Have you ever wondered what Romans 8:29 means? What about an explanation of Exodus 20:26? Whether you're seeking clarity or deeper insight, this program promises to enrich your understanding of scripture and your faith journey.


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1.  Why does God allow so much suffering for one person?  

2. One of the 10 commandments is "Thou shall not kill" But when I read the book of Judges, God Himself sends a judge to kill kings in order to deliver the children of Israel. There are other stories where the kings are killed. How do you explain this? Couldn't God have used other ways to get rid of those kings and other people? Why did God send a judge to kill kings?

3.  Is it a sin to disbelieve God? 

4.  Can you please explain Exodus 20:26? Someone said this is talking about women going up on the rostrum in church not properly dressed. 

5.   I am reading Conflict of the Ages and am currently in the section entitled "The Plan of Redemption". There is a phrase regarding Christ leaving His glory to take upon himself human nature. This was a mystery the sinless intelligences of other worlds desired to understand." My question is, are there any Bible passages that might describe who these other intelligences are? 

6.  What does Romans 8:29 mean? I am confused by the word 'predestined' as it sounds contrary to our free will. 

7.   How do I know Jesus has come into my heart?  

8.   I know that God gave us the gift of marital sexual relations for procreation. My husband and I are both well past the childbearing age but we still enjoy our sexual relationship. Are we sinning?   Is it a sin to enjoy sexual relations after childbearing age?

9.   Should we pray to God in our minds (especially our plans and petitions) so Satan can't hear and try to answer them impersonating God or try to damage our plans? One day my prayer was answered and I didn't know if it was God or Satan because I prayed for it out loud and the answer left bittersweet consequences. I've decided since to pray in my mind for things I don't want to get confused about. It seems like common sense to me now but I'd like to know if this is what we should be doing or if it doesn't matter. Should we pray out loud or silently?

10.  How can Satan be a dragon in Heaven if dragons aren't supposed to be real?  

11. I'm confused, when Jesus Christ was pierced at his side, it mentions blood and water came out of his body. Where did the water come from? How did the water get into His body? Did our Heavenly Father die of a broken heart? How did Jesus bleed out blood and water at His crucifixion?

12.  Very little is mentioned about Eve's salvation. I'm curious as to whether she was saved or not. Was she forgiven for her transgression and will she make it to Heaven?  Was Eve forgiven for her sins?
